TASK T70 · W4 · Detections D1–D4 on every run: decisions, trace and review page
GOAL: Every `roster run` evaluates detections D1–D4 (src/obs/detections.ts, merged) over its replays and records them where a judge sees
them: decisions.json, the neatlogs trace (span attributes) and the review page.
READ: src/obs/detections.ts (detect), src/agent/coordinator.ts (end of run, decisions.json), src/agent/backend.ts (replay rows),
src/obs/index.ts (withSpan, attributes), web/app/r/[owner]/[repo]/page.tsx, reports/self/review-1b/replays.json (real rows to test with).
OWNS: src/agent/coordinator.ts (end-of-run block only), web/components/Detections.tsx (new), web/app/r/[owner]/[repo]/page.tsx (render the
component only), scripts/experiments/detections-review-1b.ts (new: runs detect over reports/self/review-1b/replays.json and writes
reports/self/review-1b/detections.json), tests/run-detections.test.ts
BUILD: At the end of a run, call detect() with the run's replays (incumbent = the plan's suspect) and add `detections` to decisions.json.
Emit one GUARDRAIL span per detection with roster.* attributes. The review page shows a Detections section when a decisions.json with
detections exists. The script applies the same to review 1b's saved replays.
ACCEPTANCE: a scripted run with a silent pass (suite ok, hidden fail) has D1 in decisions.json; the script writes detections.json for
review 1b; `cd web && bun run build` succeeds.
TEST: bun test tests/run-detections.test.ts && (cd web && bun run build) && bun run typecheck
DO NOT TOUCH: anything outside OWNS.

content.text:
Every run now evaluates D1–D4 at the end and records the results in decisions.json, the neatlogs trace and the review page. All three acceptance checks pass. I committed it as 122ff28.

**What I built**
- **`src/agent/coordinator.ts`, end-of-run block:**
  - It fetches replays for each of the run's plans from `backend.getReplayResults`. A backend error counts as no replays for that plan.
  - It calls `detect()` with the last plan's suspect as the incumbent.
  - It adds `detections` to decisions.json.
  - It emits one GUARDRAIL span per detection, named `detection Dn`. Each carries `roster.setup`, `roster.task` and `roster.repo`, plus `roster.detection` and `roster.detection_detail`. I set the last two directly on the span, because `attributes.ts` is outside what I own.
  - I added an exported helper, `detectionsFor(replays, incumbent)`, which the review 1b script reuses.
- **`web/components/Detections.tsx` and the review page:** The page shows a Detections section when the review's data directory has a `decisions.json` with `detections`, or else a `detections.json`. Otherwise it shows nothing.
- **`scripts/experiments/detections-review-1b.ts`:** It runs the detections over review 1b's `replays.json` and writes `reports/self/review-1b/detections.json`. I ran it and committed the output. It found 16 detections, all D1 (visible suite passed, hidden tests failed). In one of them, `E` on task `8d77769a`, the scope guard also failed.

**Choices that affect what fires**
- A null `hidden_pass` or `scope_ok` (a track with no signal) is not treated as a failure.
- D2 never fires on a run, because replay rows carry no unmapped-line data.

**Test output**
- `bun test tests/run-detections.test.ts`: 4 pass. They cover a scripted silent pass giving D1 in decisions.json, an empty run, D3/D4 and null handling, and the script.
- `bun run typecheck`: clean.
- `cd web && bun run build`: succeeds. The worktree had no `web/node_modules`, so I ran `bun install --cwd web` first.
- **Full suite:** The single `bun test` run reported 1038 pass, 1 fail and 1 error, but I only kept the summary tail, so I don't know which test failed. I then ran the suite in two halves (tests/a*–i* and tests/j*–z*) and got 464 and 581 passes with 0 failures. That suggests a flaky test under load, since a second full run was going in the background at the time, but I did not reproduce the failure or identify the test.

**Changes to shared files**
- No change to `src/types.ts`.
- Nothing unfinished.
